experiment_data.hypothesis: Qwen-14B KL 30% s456 benchmark eval (WikiText-2 PPL + 5 downstream: ARC/WG/HS/PIQA/MMLU) with TEAL uniform allocation. Multi-seed replication to confirm MMLU reversal is systematic. GSM8K excluded due to generate_until cost on 14B.

reproduce.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/distill_sparse_swiglu && export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache && export HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 && export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 && export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 && export WANDB_MODE=disabled && export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 && python -u src/benchmark_eval.py --exp_id qwen14b_kl30_s456_eval_v2 --model_name_or_path /root/autodl-tmp/models/qwen2.5-14b/ --checkpoint checkpoints/qwen14b_kl30_s456/predictor_kl_normalized.pt --sparsity_mode teal_global --sparsity_target 0.3 --allocation uniform --tasks wikitext2,arc_challenge,winogrande,hellaswag,piqa,mmlu --seq_len 2048 --gpu 0 2>&1"
